summary: My Rates — Market Pulse style 365-day rate grid endpoints fully tested. All 28 tests passed covering: GET grid (defaults, custom params, invalid date 400, days clamping, stats, row structure, property 'all'), POST override (save, verify persistence, idempotency, zero/negative ignored, all fields, empty changes), DELETE override (removes record, nonexistent returns 0), POST submit-to-pms (queues rates, effective rate priority, updates live_pms_rate, guardrails), AI Sentinel rate calculation, and auth/role restrictions.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/rates/grid/{property_id} correctly defaults to today and 90 days when params missing
Days parameter clamped to 1..365 (0 treated as 'use default 90')
POST /api/rates/grid/override correctly upserts to owner_rate_overrides collection (idempotent)
Zero/negative numeric values correctly ignored in override (only positive numbers saved)
POST /api/rates/grid/submit-to-pms correctly calculates effective rate: pms_override > target_sell_rate > live_pms_rate
Guardrail correctly applied: effective = max(effective, min_rate, floor_rate)
AI Sentinel rate calculation respects min_rate and floor_rate guardrails
Auth required on all endpoints (401/403 without token)
Role restriction works: only admin/manager can access (receptionist/housekeeper get 403)
seed_data_creation: Test overrides created with dates 2027-01-10, 2027-01-11, 2027-01-12 and cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rates grid endpoints fully tested. Uses owner_rate_overrides collection (separate from rate_overrides used by market-robot). Uses rate_sync_queue for submit-to-pms output. Property 'all' and 'default' both valid. Total rooms from rooms collection, default_rate from rate_plans collection.
